newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower as profit taking by small investors pulled down prices of major engineering, pharmaceutical, food and leather scrips, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 14.81 points or 1.26 percent at 1,151.67 on a turnover of 54.5 million taka. Of 124 traded issues 82 lost, 38 rose and four were unchanged.
Brokers said small investors cashed in gains from price rises in the two previous sessions. Aftab Automobiles lost 30 taka to 407, Apex Foods shed 60 to 2,021 and ACI was down 5.24 to 139.24.
